I need to convert 5:00 PM Berlin time on October 28, 2026 to New York time.

On October 28, 2026:
- Berlin is on CET (UTC+1) — EU daylight saving ends October 25, 2026, so Berlin is back to standard time (CET, UTC+1).
- New York is on EDT (UTC-4) — US daylight saving ends November 1, 2026, so New York is still on EDT.

Difference: Berlin (UTC+1) to New York (UTC-4) = 5 hours behind.

5:00 PM − 5 hours = 12:00 PM (noon).
